headline: Brazil Ibovespa Rises Above 168,000 Points Supported by Wall Street Rebound
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa index rose 1.39% to close at 168,498.45 points, aided by Wall Street's technology sector recovery, though recording a modest weekly gain of 0.30%.
why: Latin American equity benchmarks frequently track US market direction and risk sentiment shifts in developed economies.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Positive spillover from Wall Street's tech sector recovery lifted domestic Brazilian equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A rebound in US technology stocks spilled over into emerging market equities, driving the Ibovespa higher.
